data.narrative:
Make Sunsets is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Luke Iseman and Andrew Song that has raised $0.8M to date. The valuation universe comprises 8 private peers in Climate & Energy alongside 1 public comparable (Lnza), though narrow peer filtering by stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient density for a reliable peer-median approach.

Stage-progression methodology was the primary applicable lens. Using the $800K total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $2M. Peer-median triangulation was not executable: while 8 same-sector companies exist (including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix), none matched narrow stage or adjacent-stage filters with sufficient frequency to generate reliable statistical weight. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce material bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.7M–$2.3M, centered on $2M. This estimate rests primarily on stage-appropriate progression mechanics rather than peer anchoring. Key uncertainties include the absence of directly comparable Seed-stage Climate & Energy companies in available datasets and dependency on the $800K raised as a conservative valuation proxy. Sensitivity to the stage-progression multiplier (typically 2.0–3.0x) represents the largest analytical lever.
